questions.question: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus called a judging person a hypocrite. What did He say that person should do first?

answers.text: Take the beam out of your own eye

questions.question: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus said the wide gate and broad way lead to what?
Jesus said not everyone who calls Him Lord will enter the kingdom of heaven. Who will enter?

answers.text: The one who does His Father's will
The one who prays the longest
The one who knows the most Scripture
